DNXA-116 is an 802.11n dual-band 2x2 mPCIe which delivers up to 300Mbps data rate. Enhanced rate-over-range, lower power consumption, and fast channel 2.4/5GHz switch enable DNXA-116 to deliver the ultimate wireless triple play experience for video, voice, and data transmission.
